one_liner: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, and project management with a comprehensive REST API and official MCP support.
access_notes: API access is self-serve on all Notion pricing tiers including the free plan, with optional security review required for public marketplace listings.
verdict_reason: Notion provides self-serve credentials on all plans, robust REST API documentation, and an official MCP server.

evidence.snippet: Bearer tokens are provided when you create an internal connection, create a personal access token, or complete the OAuth flow for a public connection.
Self-serve for any Notion workspace user; no plan requirement is stated, but public connections need Notion security review before Marketplace listing.
With the REST API, you can read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace — pages, databases, users, comments, and more.
Connections can subscribe to real-time events — like page updates, property changes, and new comments — via webhooks.
